scope: Agentic skill metadata generation and validation entrypoint
summary: Both the system Python and project virtualenv entrypoints failed before skill validation because PyYAML was intentionally absent from the lightweight project dependencies.
evidence: The first generator attempt with system Python failed on the missing yaml module.
The second generator attempt with .venv Python failed on the same missing yaml module; no repository dependency was added.
lessons: Skill tooling dependencies must stay outside PhiAgent's lightweight runtime contract and be provisioned in an isolated tool environment.
limitations: These two entrypoints did not validate the updated skill.
next_actions: Install PyYAML into a temporary isolated path and rerun the official generator, quick validator, and SkillHone static check.
